changelog: v0.4.0: Meta Quest 3 WebGPU flag detection & intelligent user alerts: 1) Added checkQuestWebGPUFlagStatus() detecting if chrome://flags WebGPU is disabled vs enabled on Quest 3; 2) Live status indicator in Settings showing exact flag status (🟢 Enabled / 🔴 Disabled); 3) Dedicated Quest 3 WebGPU Alert modal explaining why local models cannot run without GPU compute shaders; 4) One-click 'Switch to Google Gemini Cloud' button inside the alert for instant zero-flag VR chat; 5) Clear step-by-step instructions on enabling chrome://flags#enable-unsafe-webgpu; 6) Automatic alert triggers on Quest 3 when attempting to select or prompt local model with disabled flag.
